subject: opts_chunk$set inside child document not working

messages.author: aa8d8a5c39930fde
messages.subject: opts_chunk$set inside child document not working
parts:
I am having difficulties setting chunk options globally inside a child node. For example: 

init.Rhtml:
----------
<!--begin.rcode setup, echo=FALSE
opts_chunk$set(dev  = "tikz")
end.rcode-->
----------

foo.Rhtml:
----------
<!--begin.rcode setup, child="init.Rhtml"
end.rcode-->

<!--begin.rcode 
opts_chunk$get("dev")
end.rcode-->

----------

after running this I get 

opts_chunk$get("dev")
## [1] "png"

which contradicts the chunk options that I meant to set in init.Rhtml. 

Any ideas what is the problem?

messages.author: aa8d8a5c39930fde
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] opts_chunk$set inside child document not working
parts:
I think the following is fixed now:

opts_chunk$set(...) in a child node persists properly in parent.

But I think there is another similar problem, this time with opts_knit$set - it does not persist properly in the parent node.

For example, if I put the following in the child node:

opts_knit$set(upload.fun = function(x) {
  x1 = sub('\\.pdf$', '.png', x)
  system(paste('convert', x, x1))
  x1
})

and in the parent node: 

<!--begin.rcode basicDefinitions, child="../init.Rhtml" 
end.rcode-->

<!--begin.rcode ber01
opts_knit$get("upload.fun")
end.rcode-->

I get 

# function (x) 
## x
## <bytecode: 0x105d60740>
## <environment: namespace:base>

which is not what it should be. This works fine by the way if I put the opts_knit line in the parent document.
Any ideas what is the problem?

Thanks,
Guy

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] opts_chunk$set inside child document not working
parts:
Both this problem and the very first problem were due to the fact that
any options set in the child documents will be restored after the
exiting the child document. I will fix it soon.
